framing: native vertical 9:16, picture fills the whole tall frame
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright midday sunlight
character: plump green garden snail, heavy sleepy eyelids over amber eyes, long swinging eyestalks, spiral shell, fills two thirds of the frame
props: a yellow ruler it crawls along; a brisk ant accountant in a tie with coins; a tower of coins; a straw hat; a deck chair; a daisy; the reporter striped sleeve and microphone at the lens
prop_continuity: snail past mark one from 0.45, two from 2.55, three from 9.05; tower stacking from 1.95, toppled from 6.35; hat flat from 7.25; daisy bare from 8.15
motion_rule: the camera travels every window and never holds, new shot size every window; the snail oozes forward and works its mouth in every window, and never holds a pose, not even the last; the ant laps the ruler in every window
environment: sunlit garden table of old planks, daisies, blurred green hedge behind

audio.delivery: heavy drawling snail voice, native Russian stress

audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 6.35
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: coins clinking, planks creaking, tiny running feet
